integrity: The proof reduces the two fixed-density rankings to maximum degree versus total pairwise degree spread, then exhaustively enumerates every connected simple graph through five vertices and canonicalizes by vertex relabeling. The unique sharp pair and both normalized index values are replayed from the embedded verifier.
scientific_limitations: The theorem compares connected finite simple undirected graphs only at equal order and equal edge count. It concerns Freeman centralization derived from degree centrality and the Gini coefficient of the degree multiset; it does not extend automatically to other centrality scores or to changing density.
title: Five vertices are the sharp fixed-density disagreement boundary for degree centralization and degree Gini
